OSPF costing now supports independent left/right Add and Multiply adjustments, followed by a shared Floor step (default 5). Compact previews and approvals show both endpoint targets; actual reported costs remain separate.

New OSPF plans default to Automatic. Existing plans receive neutral adjustments and Floor 5 while retaining their saved modes, reported costs and accepted job targets. Flooring can change recommendations under the existing approval and health gates.

Update the server, frontend, CLI and agents together; new OSPF commands require protocol 9. The server applies the migration automatically. Refresh old edit/approval snapshots; CLI cost updates now require separate left and right targets.
